Recommendation: Rescue driftwood, build a sheltered raft and shift cargo against nine side swells. Fit useful floats, a cargo net and a bilge pump, then bring your finished home into Lantern Bay.
Drag a small hand of wood and stone cards into a snowy camp. Build before the weather turns and keep the fire alive for three nights.
Tap to jump across the canyon, collect timber and hold to lash permanent bridges that become your new safe checkpoints.
Dig connected tunnels, haul ore back to daylight and use it to improve your lantern, tunnel supports and cargo lift.
Saw along the guide, hammer each nail and install three handmade upgrades at a close-up first-person woodworking bench.
Gather dew and draw living vines. Prune, undo and grow a real leafy roof that blocks rain above all seven seedlings.
Rotate a tiny planet to salvage metal and catch sunlight. Build panels, storage and cables to keep a night-side habitat lit.
Record your real footsteps and replay two past selves. Coordinate plates and a timed release to build a rescue beacon together.
